records.title: test(lsp): preserve changed test-file exclusion
records.release_claim: changed test files do not become production gap-diagnostic anchors
records.reason: This regression is part of the same production-scope invariant later broadened by #2158 and prevents inverted editor guidance.
records.non_claim: Does not prove CLI/LSP output-count parity or every language adapter's test-file policy.

records.title: ux(vscode): quick-pick workspace root for ambiguous multi-root starts
records.release_claim: an ambiguous multi-root start has an in-product, session-bounded recovery path
records.reason: Without this command the packaged extension can correctly block but provides no usable path to select the one-server root.
records.non_claim: The single-server, one-root-at-a-time model remains unchanged.

records.title: security(lsp): bound transport framing, payloads, concurrency, and slow readers
records.release_claim: the public stdio server has explicit finite framing, payload, concurrency, and slow-reader bounds
records.reason: The old candidate leaves attacker-controlled JSON-RPC framing and several request collections unbounded, contradicting the current reliability and security narrative.
records.non_claim: The transport does not provide wire-level frame recovery or a configurable internal queue without upstream changes.
